I’m James, I’m an experienced data professional, communicator and mentor, currently working in healthcare analytics and modelling. Before that, I worked in digital marketing but I’m also interested in human factors research, econometrics, polling and urban design.

title: About me
text:
Statistician/Information Analyst
Public Health Scotland, Present

Exhibited patient clustering analysis at an NHS conference.
Used SES models to forecast bed occupancy in Ayrshire community hospitals.
Built zero-inflated regression models to analyse effect of staffing levels on patient safety.
Made a Leaflet map showing health service accessibility via public/active transport using open data.

Applied linear interpolation and calculus techniques to measure compliance against national care standards.
See work GitHub account here.

title: About me
text:
Senior Writer and Analyst
CopyHouse, 2021-2024

Managed and led projects for highest margin accounts.
Onboarded new staff as organisation grew 900% YOY.
Achieved 97% client satisfaction score in annual survey.

Expanded company services to include data analysis on web traffic, SEO strategy.

title: About me
text:
MSc Applied Data Analytics
University of the Highlands and Islands, Present

Achieved 78% module average so far with a maximum of 90%.
Data Lab Scholarship recipient. Studying alongside full-time employment.

Module specialisms include statistical modelling, machine learning and geospatial analysis in R/Python.

title: About me
text:
BSc Psychology
Heriot-Watt University, Graduated with First Class Honours*

Awarded Brotherton Project Prize, a departmental award given to the best student Honours project each academic year for my dissertation on cognitive factors within political messaging campaigns.
Won Best Speaker at a British Psychological Society conference while exhibiting my research.
Experience in experimental cognitive neuroscience research involving vulnerable demographics.
